visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female dermatologist with short brown hair and round glasses is shown in a medium close-up, seated in an office. She wears a sleeveless yellow floral blouse. The background is a professional office with a computer monitor, framed certificates, and a soft-lit bookshelf. (2) She speaks directly to the camera, using precise hand gestures to explain skin conditions. Dynamic text overlays in white and yellow appear in the lower half of the frame, highlighting technical terms. (3) The camera uses jump cuts to maintain a fast narrative pace as she compares different laser technologies. She points to her own skin while explaining the depth of treatments, maintaining a focused and professional facial expression. (4) The video concludes with a clean graphic transition to a white screen displaying the clinic's logo, social media handles, phone numbers, and two branch addresses in Sanchong and Zhongshan districts.
